params.name: placementId
params.description:
A system-generated unique identifier for a Placement, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. placementId=placement1,placement2,placement3.

params.name: documentId
params.description:
A system-generated identifier for each Document record, with a format and structure defined by the technology used. This identifier is used to group multiple versions of Document records together.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. documentId=id1,id2,id3.

params.name: createdDate
params.description:
The date timestamp when the entity was created.
Search using range method, e.g. createdDate=range(date1,date2).

params.name: modifiedDate
params.description:
The date timestamp when the entity was modified.
Search using range method, e.g. modifiedDate=range(date1,date2).

params.name: uploadUserEmail
params.description:
The User email of the User that uploaded the Document.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. uploadUserEmail=email1,email2,email3.

params.name: uploadUserFirstName
params.description:
The first name of the User that uploaded the Document.
Search using contains method, e.g. uploadUserFirstName=contains(astring).

params.name: uploadUserLastName
params.description:
The last name of the User that uploaded the Document.
Search using contains method, e.g. uploadUserLastName=contains(astring).

params.name: teamName
params.description:
The name of the Broker Team, as defined by the broker organisation.
Search using contains method, e.g. teamName=contains(astring).

params.name: fileName
params.description:
The file name of the Document, including its file extension.
Search using contains method, e.g. fileName=contains(astring).

params.name: description
params.description:
A description about the Document and / or its contents.
Search using contains method, e.g. description=contains(astring).

params.name: classType
params.description:
A code that describes the class of Document. Examples include Digitised MRC, Non-digitised MRC or Supporting Document.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. classType=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: type
params.description:
A code that represents the type of Document.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. type=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: contextType
params.description:
Identifies where within a Placement structure this Document is held.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. contextType=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: contextId
params.description:
The unique identifier given within the hierarchy of the Placement structure where the Document is held.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. contextId=id1,id2,id3.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorting field and order (unique field only).
Use + before the field name for ascending order, use - for descending order.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Number of the page to be retrieved.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Size of the page to be retrieved.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Document records associated within a specified Placement structure, based upon various query parameters. Pagination functionality is supported on this operation.

Creates a Document record, representing either the Market Reform Contract (MRC) or another type of supporting document. The request contains the document attributes as well as the electronic file which will be submitted into the platform's content management system. This end point will also be used for when an electronic file is to be replaced, i.e. versioned.

params.name: documentVersionId
params.description: A system-generated unique identifier for a Document Version, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.

items.docs: Returns a single Document record. This record will contain the document attributes of the document, but does not provide the electronic file.

params.name: documentVersionId
params.description: A system-generated unique identifier for a Document Version, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.

items.docs: Updates the data attributes of a Document record. This operation will not replace the electronic file.
